caption: The drawing features a central, symmetrical abstract figure primarily composed of red and blue lines and shapes, positioned against a plain, light beige background. The main element is a vertically oriented, rectangular frame outlined in red, with stylized, curved extensions emerging from both sides near the top and bottom; these extensions curve outward and upward, resembling organic or plant-like motifs, and terminate in smaller looped shapes partially filled with blue. At the top of the rectangle, above a triangular roof-like structure bordered in blue, there is a large red oval or circle, surrounded by short blue lines radiating outward, giving an impression of rays or emanation. Below the main rectangle is a supporting structure formed by two red, curved lines meeting at a red oval, with a short blue base line at the bottom. The composition is centered on the page, with faint, soft shading around the figure, and the artist's signature "c. chipicototla" is visible in small, black handwriting toward the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Wall Painting
